title_zh: 蚂蚁国际推出AI智能体Wyn，帮助中小企业管理全球账户
title_en: Ant International launches AI agent Wyn to help SMEs manage global accounts

paragraphs.zh: 10月16日，蚂蚁国际在第140届广交会上发布了新一代全球账户智能体Wyn。它主要为做跨境贸易的中小企业服务，现在已经在万里汇的App和网站上线。
paragraphs.en: On October 16, Ant International launched Wyn, a new-generation global account AI agent, at the 140th Canton Fair. It mainly serves small and medium-sized businesses engaged in cross-border trade, and it is already live on the WorldFirst app and website.

paragraphs.zh: 以前，商家开收款账户、换外汇，要打开很多页面，填很多表格。现在，用户只需要在一个对话窗口里说一句话，Wyn就能帮忙完成。经过用户授权以后，它还能和物流、广告、税务等服务商的智能体连接，帮商家查余额、充值。
paragraphs.en: In the past, to open a collection account or exchange foreign currency, merchants had to open many pages and fill in many forms. Now users only need to say one sentence in a chat window, and Wyn can get it done. With the user's authorisation, it can also connect with the AI agents of logistics, advertising, tax and other service providers to check balances and top up accounts for merchants.

paragraphs.zh: 在资金管理方面，Wyn会根据实时数据生成看板，告诉商家资金够不够、什么时候可能有风险，并及时提醒。蚂蚁国际还推出了一个保障机制：如果智能体误解了用户的意思并造成资金损失，用户可以得到赔付。
paragraphs.en: For fund management, Wyn builds dashboards from real-time data, tells merchants whether they have enough funds and when risks may appear, and sends timely alerts. Ant International has also introduced a protection mechanism: if the agent misunderstands what the user meant and this causes a financial loss, the user can be compensated.

paragraphs.zh: 据中国信通院今年3月的报告，只有23%的中小企业在核心业务中使用了AI，因此这个市场还有很大的空间。蚂蚁国际高级副总裁石文宜表示，2026年是全球电商和贸易行业拥抱AI转型的一年。
paragraphs.en: According to a March report from the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT), only 23% of SMEs use AI in their core business, so this market still has a lot of room to grow. Shi Wenyi, a senior vice president of Ant International, said 2026 is the year the global e-commerce and trade industries embrace AI transformation.

vocab.en: Canton Fair (China Import and Export Fair)
to go live; to launch online
to top up; to recharge (an account)
to compensate; to pay out (a claim)
according to (据…报告 / 据报道)
CAICT (China Academy of Information and Communications Technology)

featured.note: Very common in payments: 中小商家 (small merchants), 商家入驻 (merchant onboarding onto a platform), 商家端 (merchant-side app), 商家服务 (merchant services).

examples.zh: 很多支付平台为中小商家提供免费的收款码。
examples.py: Hěn duō zhīfù píngtái wèi zhōngxiǎo shāngjiā tígōng miǎnfèi de shōukuǎn mǎ.
examples.en: Many payment platforms give small merchants free payment QR codes.

examples.zh: 这条街上的商家都可以用手机付款。
examples.py: Zhè tiáo jiē shang de shāngjiā dōu kěyǐ yòng shǒujī fùkuǎn.
examples.en: All the shops on this street accept mobile payment.

examples.zh: 我们发现，上个月新注册的商家里，只有一半完成了第一笔交易。
examples.py: Wǒmen fāxiàn, shàng ge yuè xīn zhùcè de shāngjiā lǐ, zhǐyǒu yíbàn wánchéng le dì yī bǐ jiāoyì.
examples.en: We found that of the merchants who registered last month, only half completed their first transaction.

featured.note: Used before a noun: 跨境支付 (cross-border payment), 跨境电商 (cross-border e-commerce), 跨境贸易 (cross-border trade), 跨境转账/汇款 (cross-border transfer/remittance).

examples.zh: 跨境支付正在变得更快、更便宜。
examples.py: Kuàjìng zhīfù zhèngzài biàn de gèng kuài, gèng piányi.
examples.en: Cross-border payments are becoming faster and cheaper.

examples.zh: 我妈妈经常在跨境电商平台上买日本的化妆品。
examples.py: Wǒ māma jīngcháng zài kuàjìng diànshāng píngtái shang mǎi Rìběn de huàzhuāngpǐn.
examples.en: My mom often buys Japanese cosmetics on cross-border e-commerce platforms.

examples.zh: 经理让我分析一下哪些客户最常用跨境转账功能。
examples.py: Jīnglǐ ràng wǒ fēnxī yíxià nǎxiē kèhù zuì cháng yòng kuàjìng zhuǎnzhàng gōngnéng.
examples.en: My manager asked me to analyse which customers use the cross-border transfer feature most.
